t: Visit Of Major-General S. Hasebe To Shanghai

pages.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ............
Date. April 22, ...... 1937
Subject ......... Visit of Major-General S. Hasebe to Shanghai.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by Iboyn D.S.I

Information has been received that Major-General
S.HASEBE, reported to be employed with the South Manchurian Rail-
way in the capacity of a Liason Officer with Headquarters of the
Japanese Army in Kwantung, arrived in Shanghai from Dairen on
April 6, 1937. He resided at the Tokiwa Hotel, 430 Chapoo Road un-
til April 19, when he is reported to have left for Tientsin via
Nanking. He intended to stay in Nanking for a day or two.

While in Shanghai he is reported to have been interested
among other things, in collecting information on the following
points:-

1. Signs, if any, indicating preparations for a war on
the part of the U.S.S.R.

2. Details of disagreements existing among "White
Russians" over the question of the attitude to be adopted by them
in the event of war between the U.S.S.R. and Japan.

3. Relations existing between the "White" and "Red"
sections of the local Russian community.

Major-General Hasebe is reported to have been in com-
mand of the Japanese troops which occupied Harbin in 1932, and to
have served with the XXIII Corps of the Russian Army for a
period during the Great War.

He was accompanied by his secretary, a certain N.R.
Sobolevsky, 43. The latter individual is reported to be leaving
for Dairen to-day.

General Hasebe's visit to Shanghai may account for
the report of the "Novosti Dnia", April 19, 1937, stating that agents
arrived in Shanghai from Manchuria recently with a view to the re-
cruiting young men among the local Russian community for service
with the Japanese auxiliary troops in Manchuria.

（左侧批注及印章：）
BGS.
J.c R.

机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告
档案号 ............
日期：1937年4月22日
事由：长谷部少将（Major-General S. Hasebe）访问上海。
由普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）副督察撰写。由伊博因（Iboyn）副督察转呈

据获情报，据报在关东军司令部担任联络官职务、任职于南满洲铁道株式会社的长谷部少将（S. HASEBE），于1937年4月6日从大连抵达上海。他居住在乍浦路430号的常盘酒店（Tokiwa Hotel），直至4月19日，据报经南京前往天津。他计划在南京停留一两天。

据报他在上海期间，除其他事项外，对收集以下方面的信息颇感兴趣：

1. 苏联方面是否有备战迹象。

2. “白俄”之间就若苏日发生战争应采取何种态度这一问题存在的分歧细节。

3. 当地俄国社群中“白”派与“红”派之间现存的关系。

据报长谷部少将曾指挥1932年占领哈尔滨的日军部队，并在第一次世界大战期间曾在俄军第二十三军服役一段时间。

随同他前来的有他的秘书，一名叫N.R.索博列夫斯基（Sobolevsky）的男子，43岁。据报此人今日将前往大连。

长谷部将军访问上海一事，或许可以解释《每日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）1937年4月19日的报道，该报道称特工近期从满洲抵达上海，旨在从当地俄国社群中招募青年男子，为满洲的日军辅助部队服役。

（左侧批注及印章：）

J.c R.
